module.title: Graph Projections for Relationships, Referrals and Risk
module.business_purpose: Supports multi-hop relationship analysis for referrals, organizational networks, counterparties, fraud, delegated access and lineage. The graph is optional and derived. PostgreSQL remains canonical for identities, contracts, claims, payments and clinical records.
